answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a relic seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 100 aliases trips the duplicate check at the reef gate. The trellis receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. Honest users pay that once, farms 9 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
